parts.style: warm, gentle late-night welcome, a soft smile in the voice, speaking slowly
parts.text: Welcome to Finding Rest. <short pause> This practice is called Breathing Slowly. <short pause> It is a simple thing, and you already know how to do it. <short pause> We'll just do it more gently, and with God in mind.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Find a position that is easy to stay in. <short pause> Let your eyes close, or rest them on one quiet spot. <short pause> Before you change anything at all, notice the breath you already have. <short pause> Where do you feel it? <short pause> In your nose... your chest... or low in your belly?

parts.style: gentle, a soft smile in the voice, illustrating
parts.text: Most of the day, we never think about breathing. <short pause> It carries on through meetings and traffic, through worry and laughter. <short pause> All day long, you have been given breath after breath... <short pause> and you didn't have to earn a single one.
The Bible begins our story with that gift. <short pause> Before the first person had done any work, or said any prayer, God drew near. <short pause> We read it in Genesis, chapter two, verse seven.
And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul. <long pause>

parts.style: slow, reflective, letting the words sink in
parts.text: The breath of life. <short pause> It came from Him first. <short pause> So this breath is more than air. <short pause> It is a small reminder that you are made, and known, and kept.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: We'll breathe in for a slow count of three, and out for a count of four. <short pause> There is no need to fill your lungs all the way. <short pause> If the count doesn't suit you, let it go and follow your own rhythm. <short pause> Comfort matters more than counting.

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: Breathe in... <short pause> one... <short pause> two... <short pause> three. <short pause> And out... <short pause> one... <short pause> two... <short pause> three... <short pause> four. <short pause> Again, breathe in... <short pause> one... <short pause> two... <short pause> three. <short pause> And out... <short pause> one... <short pause> two... <short pause> three... <short pause> four.

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: Now give the breath a few words. <short pause> As you breathe in... <short pause> You give me life. <short pause> As you breathe out... <short pause> I give You my day. <short pause> In again... <short pause> You give me life. <short pause> And out... <short pause> I give You my day.

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: And let the words grow smaller. <short pause> Breathe in... <short pause> given. <short pause> Breathe out... <short pause> released. <short pause> Breathe in... <short pause> given. <short pause> Breathe out... <short pause> released.

Your mind may have wandered off while we were counting. <short pause> That is all right. <short pause> It's what minds do, especially tired ones. <short pause> You haven't failed at this. <short pause> The next breath is simply another place to begin, and there is always kindness waiting in it.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Now stop steering, and let your breathing find its own pace. <short pause> Feel your chest rise, without being told. <short pause> Feel it fall, without any help from you. <short pause> Even when you are asleep, this will go on. <short pause> You can stop being in charge for a while. <short pause> The One who gave the breath will watch over it.

Let's pray. <short pause> Creator God, <short pause> thank You for the breath You have given me today. <short pause> Where I have been hurried, slow me. <short pause> Where I have been tight and afraid, soften me. <short pause> Let every breath tonight rest in Your care, even the ones I will never notice. <short pause> Amen.

If you wake in the night, you can come straight back to this. <short pause> Nothing to work out, and nothing to solve. <short pause> Only a breath in... <short pause> given. <short pause> And a breath out... <short pause> released. <short pause> Sleep gently.
